cohort: 282 pregnant patients with epilepsy from a single tertiary care center in Toronto, Canada
finding: In a cohort of Canadian pregnant patients with epilepsy, the rates of obstetrical complications were similar to the general Canadian population, except for higher rates of cesarean section and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: The study found that the rate of cesarean section was higher among pregnant patients with epilepsy compared to the general Canadian population.
